dialogues.speaker: Hardworking Silio
dialogues.text: Me? Oh, I just help out doing bits and pieces at the Dawn Winery. Nothing particularly worth mentioning.

dialogues.speaker: Hardworking Silio
dialogues.text: I just finished a delivery, so I'm taking a short breather.

dialogues.speaker: Hardworking Silio
dialogues.text: They treat their staff really well at the winery, so I don't mind putting in a bit of extra effort.
